description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Orleans clients within various hosting frameworks in .NET, including HostBuilder, HostApplicationBuilder, and IServiceCollection. It provides methods to add Orleans client configurations, ensuring proper setup and preventing conflicts with silo configurations.

classes.name: OrleansBuilderMarker
classes.description: A marker class used to store and identify an Orleans client builder instance within a service collection.

methods.name: UseOrleansClient
methods.description: Extension methods to configure and add Orleans clients to various host builders and service collections, ensuring only one client configuration is active and preventing conflicts with silo configurations.

methods.name: AddOrleansClient
methods.description: Internal method to add and retrieve an Orleans client builder from the service collection, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: GetOrleansSiloAddedException
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that Orleans silo and client configurations should not be used together.
